name: Demo
description:
NostalgiaPE Classic — a unique server on Minecraft PE Alpha 0.8.1, recreating the atmosphere of 2013. Old world, plugins that complement the cozy gameplay and a great community.

Server features:

– Fully functioning mobs and animals with AI.

– Multi-world support.

– Server chat integrated with Discord chat.

– Custom Discord bot with in-game player statistics.

– Protection for chests and furnaces.

– In-game server economy and ChestShop system.

– Fast tree chopping with an axe.

The server uses an alternative to a whitelist — a permissions plugin for interaction rights. Without these permissions, you won’t be able to build or break blocks, but you can walk around and explore the server. To obtain them, you need to submit an application on the Discord server.

Website: https://nostalgiape.ddns.net

Discord: https://discord.com/invite/eyuGNNyFKD
